message.content: {"question":"Determine the final temperature t of a mixture, when a mass m₁=100 g of ice (fusion heat c_f=80 cal/g) at temperature t₁=0 °C is mixed with a mass m₂=500 g of water at temperature t₂=50 °C, by assuming absent the dispersion of heat with the external environment (c_w=1 cal/g is the specific heat of water).","options":{"A":"t=28.33 °C","B":"t=38.33 °C","C":"t=25.00 °C","D":"t=18.33 °C"},"correct":"A"}
